title: The Gravedigger's Lodge
objective: Find what the false gravedigger has dug up from the churchyard, and get out alive. Leave by the lychgate when you are ready.

rooms.name: Lychgate
rooms.description: A roofed gate into an overgrown churchyard. A lamp burns in the gravedigger's lodge beyond the yews.

features.name: Coffin Rest
features.description: A stone slab under the gate's roof where coffins wait for the priest.
features.discovery: Someone has left two stoppered vials of red liquid on the slab, with a note: "For whoever goes in after him."

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Dead-house
rooms.description: The lodge's cold back room, where the dead are laid out. Coffins stand open along the walls, and one has been dragged into the middle of the floor.

features.name: Dragged Coffin
features.description: A cheap pine coffin, its lid prised off.
features.discovery: The coffin is packed with grave goods: a gold mourning ring, a jet cameo, a pouch of old coin and a dark tourmaline.

items.name: Gold Mourning Ring
items.description: A heavy gold ring engraved with a name and a date.

items.name: Jet Cameo
items.description: A carved jet cameo of a woman's profile in a silver frame.

items.name: Grave Tourmaline
items.description: A long dark-green tourmaline, cut to catch the lamplight.

items.name: Grave Coin
items.description: Old gold coins, pressed onto the eyes of the dead.

items.name: False Gravedigger's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

passages.description: A path between the yews to the lodge's back door.

opponents.name: False Gravedigger
opponents.description: A bandit in a gravedigger's smock throws down a spade and draws a scimitar.

opponents.name: Risen Corpse
opponents.description: A corpse he dug up has climbed out of its coffin and lurches towards the light.

endings.title: Out with the grave goods
endings.text: You walk back out through the lychgate with the stolen grave goods, to return them or not as you please.

endings.title: Out of the churchyard
endings.text: You walk back out through the lychgate with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Laid out in the dead-house
endings.text: You fall among the open coffins. Your adventuring ends here.
